title: CrimLife
description:
A free online text-based crime and mafia RPG. Commit crimes and build your respect, stats and reputation; join or create a gang, run patrols and fight rival gangs; own factories that produce goods every in-game day; trade on the Black Market; play casino games and bet on races; avoid jail and hospital and climb the leaderboards; and chat live with other players in the Plaza.

Most of the game is menus, text and decisions with no reflex-based gameplay, so it works with screen readers. Some newer features, such as the car racing minigame, are more visual and still need accessibility work. Ads are optional; in-game coins can be used instead. Online only.
